studies.title: Mahabodhi Temple — c. 1900
studies.caption: About 1900. A tall brick tower rises beside the sacred tree at Bodh Gaya.
studies.prompt: Courtyard low three-quarter view pyramidal rectilinear Mahabodhi tower with tiers of niches and small corner towers, Bodhi foliage to side, no rounded Hindu shikhara or Chinese pagoda.
